escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a vast dark hall at night): she stands on the RIGHT half of the frame, framed from the waist up, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. Beside her, on the camera-left side between her and the empty left of the frame, floats a translucent glass card about as tall as her torso; its left edge is at about 47 % of the frame width, and between the left edge of the frame and the card there is a wide band of empty darkness. The card is a customer record made of light, with a round avatar glow at the top and SIX horizontal rows below it. Three thin streams of light travel to the card from three sources that hang far behind her, inside the right half of the frame and small: ONE glowing phone handset above and behind her right shoulder, ONE glowing envelope behind her at head height, ONE glowing calendar square lower and farther on the right; all three soft and out of focus. Where each stream touches the card, one of its rows lights up cool white-blue as if filling itself in; four rows are already lit, two are still dim and filling. The rows are abstract light bars: no letters, no numbers, nothing legible. Her hands rest relaxed, one hand lightly open toward the card without touching it — she is NOT typing, NOT writing, the record updates itself — and she looks straight into the lens with a calm, knowing half-smile. The light of the card paints her face and jacket; streams and card are cool azure blue (#0375DB) and cool white, the light of Efeonce; only the three small source icons glow magenta-pink (#E86BD0) as a sparse accent. Thin haze catches the streams. The LEFT 45% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze: no card, no streams, no objects. Rich contrast, no text, no logos of any other brand.
